contexts.text: These (wandering) Spirits apply themselves to the back part, where is the cauda equina...

Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail () = the power of elevating by the ultimate of the Sensuous... The serpent's tail = the ultimate of the Sensuous... its tail = the ultimate or lowest there... By the serpent's tail is signified falsity itself; for this is the ultimate or lowest (of that Sensuous)...
Tails like scorpions, and stings in the tails () = adroit reasonings from falsities, by which they persuade, and thus injure. AC 10071:2. ( = persuasions. DSS 13:3).

Tails like serpents () = reasonings from falsities, by which injury is inflicted; and this is still more so because it is said that such were the tails of the horses, and that they had heads. Explained. AC 10071:2.
The tail of the dragon () = reasoning from falsities... ( = truths falsified, especially by application to evils. AC 10071:end.)
That tail, in general, = the Sensuous separated, which does not look upwards, but downwards... consequently, falsity. Illustrated.
(In these passages) the tail = what is lowest, which looks downwards or outwards, that is, to the world and to the earth, and not to Heaven and the Lord. Explained.
The head and the tail () = (the interiors and the exteriors of the Church).

(Thou shalt take) the tail () = all the truth (in the Heavens); for the tail of the ram = truth. The reason the tail = truth, is that it is the ultimate, and in the ultimates is truth. Moreover the tail is the ultimate of the cerebrum and the cerebellum; for these are continued into the spinal marrow, which is terminated in the tail, which is thus their ultimate appendix; and therefore it is said that in the sacrifices the tail was to be removed near the spine of the back ().
That the tail = truth in the ultimates; and, in the opposite sense, falsity. Illustrated.

They who constituted the tail of the dragon, were they who in the world had been in faith separated from charity, and had been like the former as to their thoughts and intentions. (They who constitute its tail are they who have falsified all the truths of the Word; and therefore it is said that with its tail it dragged down the third part of the stars, that is, all the Knowledges of truth. DFaith 56:end.)

They had tails like scorpions () = the truths of the Word falsified, by means of which they induce a stupor (on the understanding). By the tail is signified the ultimate of the head, because the brain is continued through the spine into the tail; and therefore the head and the tail make a one as the first and the last. When, therefore, by the head is signified faith alone... by the tail are signified all confirmations of it in the aggregate which are from the Word, thus the truths of the Word falsified. Everyone who takes a principle of religion from his Own intelligence, and puts it for the head, takes confirming things from the Word, and puts them for a tail... As to the tail being the continuation of the brain through the spine to its ultimate... look at a dog or other; wild beast which has a tail, and coax and caress him, and you will see the crest of the back smooth down, and the tail move correspondingly; and, on the contrary, the crest will rise, if you irritate him. ( = sensuous scientifics which are persuasive. Explained. AE 559.)
The first of the understanding, which is taken for a principle (or beginning), is signified by the head; and the ultimate of it by the tail, in the following passages. Illustrated.

As the ultimate is signified by the tail, and the ultimate is the complex of all things, Jehovah said to Moses, Take hold of the tail (of the serpent)... and it was commanded that they should remove the entire tall next the spine... and sacrifice it with the fat...
There were stings in their tails () = cunning falsifications of the Word; (for) the tails = the truths of the Word falsified.

For their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and in these they do hurt () = that... they are sensuous and inverted, speaking truths with the mouth, but falsifying them from the principle which makes the head of the doctrine of their religion; and in this way they deceive. Explained. ( = that from sensuous scientifics, which are fallacies, they reason craftily. AE 581.)

His tail drew the third part of the stars of leaven, and cast them into the earth () = that by means of the falsifications of the Truths of the Word they have alienated from the Church all the spiritual Knowledges of good and truth, and have utterly destroyed them by applications to falsities. By the tail, where it treats of those who have confirmed heretical things from the Word, are signified the truths of the Word falsified. ( = the falsification and adulteration of all the Truths of the Word. AE 718.)
Like a horse tail, which, being of no avail, is cut off at pleasure.
They are like horse tails, which in many places are cut off; for people say... If they adhere to the horse, they are easily dirtied.
(Sodomites constitute) the region of the tail, where are the faeces...
But evil Spirits... have the head in the tail...
Under the cauda are the excrementitious Hells: the Hells of the Genii begin there.
(An egurgitation from the Hell of adulterers) struck the cauda with a warm feeling.
They who constitute the tail of the dragon are hypocrites of various kinds, who at heart deny God and eternal life; but yet preach them...
See Last Judgment.
Sirens cause an obstruction of the hinder part of the cauda, where the spinal marrow ceases, and a pain there...
That tails = sensuous scientifics. Illustrated.

(Thus) by the tail of the dragon is meant the falsification and adulteration of the Word from those who constitute its head, its body, and its most external parts; for its tail, like the tail of every animal, is a continuation of the spine, which is extended from the brains, and thus is moved, bent, and vibrated, according to the appetites, concupiscences, and pleasures of the head and body...

In the light of Heaven such are seen as dragons with a long tail; and, when there are a number of such, the tail has been seen extended from the south through the west into the north; and that tail has also been seen to draw down as it were the stars from heaven and cast them into the earth.
